title: Should, Must, and So
label: ch:ur-should-must-and-so
canDo: I can say what someone should do (āp ko jānā chāhiye), what I have to do (mujhe jānā paṛe gā), and what follows from a reason (is liye, to, chunāṅche).

payoff.summary: Complete UR-R269-advice-and-reasons: give advice, say what you have to do, and say what follows.
